title: Version 1.70.0
body:
Version 1.70.0 (A Builder's Delight Update!)

November 16th, 2024

Added:

  • The Material Gun is here, an all new game changing tool that allows you to easily fill and empty schematics. Simply consume some materials, make your selection, and fill in what you need!
  • You can find the Material Gun in The Oak Depot for a fee of $99,999. It has upgrades that can be purchased to increase your storage limit as well.
  • Optionally, there is a gamepass to increase the Material Gun's storage to be infinite! This also gives you ONE free Material Gun for any desires you may have.
  • Have you or a loved one ever wanted to float? Well now you can, using the freecam button in the top left! The freecam allows you to get awesome cinematic shots and pictures, with a limited travel distance that can be expanded for cash (or the new gamepass)

Changes:

  • The speaker now supports the {display_name} variable, which will format the label to be the DisplayName of the inputted user id. Basically, in 'noob' terms, if you add {display_name} to your speaker, and attach a donator output to it, it will speak the name of who donated!
  • Items outputted of refineries / forges / plankers now have a 3 second cooldown before they can go back into their same machine. We had to do this to prevent materials getting stuck repeatedly processing in the same machine. This took years to fix, isn't that crazy?
  • So, when we revamped the slot selection screen, we forgot to add back the menu that showed your slot was outdated... This is fixed! No more risks involving joining really old servers and losing content that doesn't exist yet!
  • The property selection screen now has helpful keybinds to quickly navigate through the menu. You can press E to select a property, or press A and D to switch through the options. So easy!
  • The snow particles in the ice biome have been redone to hopefully be better. It's been very hard to get these looking good!

Notes:

  • We hope you enjoy this small little update as we make progress towards the awesome Christmas update, which will include a new permanent ice revamp! Bye for now 👋

Version 1.70.1

November 17th, 2024

Changes:

  • Moved the freecam button to the top right
  • Exiting build mode now exits freecam
  • Reduced the amount of smoke for the Material Gun

Fixes:

  • The Lumite River Cave Store is now fixed
  • Fixed a bunch of errors from the Material Gun
  • Follower rewards now work again (maybe)
  • Disabled the Spooky Month badge

Version 1.70.2

November 19th, 2024

Changes:

  • Improved data saving on server close
  • Keybinds no longer show on mobile
  • Internal changes

Fixed:

  • Fixed a weird tool loss bug that happened in a very specific scenario

Version 1.70.3 (Gurtgiving)

November 28th, 2024

Added:

  • For thanksgiving, we released a limited time Gurt Ham Platter in all servers! You can find them at The Oak Depot.

Notes:

  • This will be available for a while, likely til the end of the Christmas update.
